svg.title: LNClassifier supplementary workflow DAGs
svg.desc: Independent benchmark and feature workflows, followed by seven analysis rows with compact document-shaped input references and dependency arrows. Repeated references denote the same files.
svg.text: Benchmark and feature generation run independently; their outputs converge for downstream analysis and publication.
Shared annotation and assembly for B–D: GENCODE v47 · GRCh38

g.text: Classifier benchmark, run independently of feature generation.
D · RNA structure and rG4 analysis
Separate outputs: rG4detector features + ScanFold2 features
E · Feature integration and downstream analysis
Repeated file boxes reference the same data. Features = B–D outputs; Tables and Splits = A outputs.
Supp. = supplementary matrix; Groups = uncertainty metrics and groups. Tables supply the index for merging.
